correctness.rationale: For unbiased initial sign S, E[S_sS_t]=exp(-2∫_s^t λ); integrate covariance to obtain D and justify long-time limit with geometric bound exp(-2Λ floor(u/T)). Period splitting gives D=v²/(1-exp(-2Λ))∫_0^T A(w)dw, A(w)=T^-1∫_0^T exp(-2∫_s^{s+w}λ)ds. Sliding hazards lie in [0,Λ] and have phase mean Λw/T. Strict Jensen lower bounds A; the chord from x=0 to Λ upper bounds it. Integrating proves both sharp constants. Equality in Jensen for almost every w plus Lebesgue differentiation forces λ constant a.e. Absolute continuity makes the upper-chord bound strict for positive small w for every L1 protocol; shrinking pulse protocols converge by dominated convergence to the extremal limit. Independent physical-time covariance integration for pulsed schedules confirmed strict bounds and monotone approach; this numerical check proves only selected schedules.
